summary: All H4 + H6 acceptance criteria are met. Migration is genuinely enabled, the dispatch guard is in place, MIN/MAX_CONDITIONS are raised, and tests cover both enabled/disabled paths. Performance cost of the new migration is reasonable (~90 single-chromosome re-evals per run, <<0.2% of the main evolution budget). Edge cases (1 cluster, missing migrants, eval errors) are already covered by the surrounding code in phase2_island_scheduler.py.

All 109 selected tests + 18 migration/island tests pass.

agents_md_compliance.evidence: evaluator_v5.ipynb untouched. .venv used. Tests run with PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1. No changes outside scope.

performance_analysis.migration_events_per_run: 3 (with default config: 3 clusters, 44 gens/cluster, 15 gens/epoch, 9 cluster-epoch iterations, 3 outer rounds)
performance_analysis.explanation: epoch_counter increments per cluster per round (line 360, inside the inner for loop), but the migration guard (line 363-366) sits OUTSIDE the for loop, so it only fires at the end of each outer round. With interval=1, 9 % 1 = 0 is always true → migration fires at end of round 1, 2, 3. Note: interval=1 and interval=3 are functionally equivalent for the default 3-cluster config (both fire every round); interval=2 would fire only once. This is a subtle but harmless quirk of the counter placement.
performance_analysis.re_evaluations_per_migration_event: 30 (3 targets × 2 non-target sources × 5 top_k migrants per source). Each calls _migrant_to_metrics which does 1 train backtest + 1 val backtest (single chromosome).
performance_analysis.total_re_evaluations_per_run: 90 (3 events × 30 re-evals × 1 train + 1 val backtest = 180 backtests).
performance_analysis.fraction_of_total_evolution_budget: Main evolution = 132 gens × 3 clusters × 200 pop_size = 79,200 chromosome evaluations. Migration overhead = 180 backtests ≈ 0.23% of main budget. Negligible.
performance_analysis.verdict: Migration frequency is REASONABLE. The 90 single-chromosome re-evaluations per run are dominated by the main NSGA-III loop. No GPU re-evaluation concern (CPU backtest engine used in _migrant_to_metrics via val_engine.simulate_rule_batch and _evaluate_chromosome). No need to fall back to Option B (PHASE2_N_CLUSTERS=1).

test_quality_notes.renamed_class: TestMigrationDisabledByDefault → TestMigrationEnabledByDefault. The rename correctly reflects the new default behavior, and the new test pair (allows / prevents) covers both paths explicitly.
test_quality_notes.synthetic_epoch_counter: Tests use hardcoded epoch_counter=2, which works for any interval value. This means a regression in the counter-placement (e.g. moving epoch_counter inside the for loop) would not be caught by these tests. However, the placement is unchanged from the pre-task-17 code, so this is a pre-existing concern, not a regression introduced by task-17.
test_quality_notes.redundancy: test_guard_allows_migration_block and test_guard_prevents_migration_when_disabled have very similar structure. Could be parameterized, but explicit tests are more readable for a safety-critical guard. Not a blocker.

code_smell_observations.epoch_counter_semantics: Minor: epoch_counter counts cluster-iterations but the check happens once per outer round. With 3 clusters, interval=1 and interval=3 behave identically. A future maintainer might expect interval=1 to mean 'after every cluster's 15-gen epoch', which it doesn't (the check is per-round). A small inline comment would help, but this is pre-existing code structure, not introduced by task-17.
code_smell_observations.config_comment_history: The config block at lines 956-974 now has 2 stale 'was X → Y' comments from the previous defaults (lines 965 and 967). The original values are no longer the defaults after task-17, so the comments are misleading. This is a minor cleanliness issue. Could be cleaned up to just say 'top 5 migrants per source' / 'min 1.0% val return to migrate' without the history.

potential_improvements_non_blocking: Consider raising PHASE2_MIGRATION_EPOCH_INTERVAL to 3 (semantically equivalent for default config but matches the 'after every full round' intent more clearly).

Strip the 'was 5 → shrink displacement footprint' / 'was 0.0 → only genuinely-transferable rules' / 'was 5 → stronger evidence bar' history comments from config.py — they reference pre-task-17 defaults and are now misleading.
Add an integration-style test that runs a small _run_cluster_islands mock loop and counts migration invocations to guard against future off-by-errors in epoch_counter placement.
approval_rationale: All spec requirements are met. The migration overhead is <0.25% of the main evolution budget — the concern raised about excessive GPU re-evaluation is unfounded (CPU backtest, single chromosome, ~90 calls per run). Edge cases are handled in code and covered by tests. Test renames are accurate and the new test pair explicitly covers both enabled and disabled paths. AGENTS.md rules respected (no evaluator_v5 changes, no dead code, .venv used). The few code-smell observations are pre-existing or non-blocking polish items.
recommendation: Merge to main. The task is small, surgical, and correctly executed. The single-cluster edge case is already guarded and tested. The raised MIN/MAX_CONDITIONS do not break the assertion or the sparse encoding.
